decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Vincent Peyresblanques 'currently holds the position of conseiller municipal de Saint-Pardoux-le-Lac' (D1S2) and was 'elected as a conseiller municipal de Saint-Pardoux-le-Lac' (D1S8). Document D2, while narrative in style, describes him having 'filled his days as conseiller municipal de Saint-Séverin' (D2S2), indicating a former or distinct role in that location. Both positions are supported by the provided text segments and represent valid answers to the question regarding current or former positions.
